name: InvestArab USD (Bridged Arab USD) USDT
description: InvestArab USD is a USD-pegged ERC-20 token on Ethereum mainnet, issued by the InvestArab platform (a trading name of Arab Investment Company K.S.C.C., Kuwait). The ticker reflects the USD peg target; the token is not issued by Tether. All Tether tokens are pegged at 1-to-1 with a matching fiat currency and are backed 100% by Tether's Reserves. Ownership is renounced, supply is fixed at 3,300,000,000 with no mint function, and ERC-7572 contractURI metadata is set on-chain.
